definitions.gloss: to interrupt; to suspend; to discontinue; to break off
definitions.explanation: To stop an activity or process partway through, with the expectation or possibility of resuming later. Can be used both transitively (to interrupt something) and intransitively (something is interrupted).

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}が{中断|ちゅうだん}された。
{雨|あめ}で{試合|しあい}が{中断|ちゅうだん}した。
examples.english: The game was interrupted by rain.

examples.japanese: サーバーの{障害|しょうがい}により、サービスが{一時的|いちじてき}に{中断|ちゅうだん}しております。
examples.english: Due to a server failure, the service has been temporarily suspended.

notes: Used both transitively ({作業|さぎょう}を{中断|ちゅうだん}する, to suspend work) and intransitively ({作業|さぎょう}が{中断|ちゅうだん}する, work is suspended). Unlike {中止|ちゅうし} (cancellation, permanent stop), {中断|ちゅうだん} implies the activity may be resumed. Common collocations: {一時|いちじ}{中断|ちゅうだん} (temporary interruption), {中断|ちゅうだん}なく (without interruption), {中断|ちゅうだん}を{余儀|よぎ}なくされる (to be forced to suspend).
